name: threshold
description: Your Garmin data, analyzed. A private MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and every MCP client, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin Personal API key. Create one at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken

ACCESS_KEY.description: A long random secret (16+ characters) that unlocks your server. You type it when you connect an app. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

DB.description: Your private archive of Garmin data (D1).

OAUTH_KV.description: OAuth clients and tokens, plus the cached Garmin token (KV).

PLAN.description: free (default) or paid. Paid does more work per run on the Workers Paid plan.

TIMEZONE.description: Optional IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty uses your Garmin profile.

GARMIN_KEY_EXPIRES.description: Optional date your Garmin key expires (YYYY-MM-DD), for early warnings.
